heldout_definition: Excluded from prompt development. These pages were included in prior full-book model inputs and some evaluator source inspections; not claimed unseen in training or previous inference.
freeze_policy: Freeze prompt, questions, snapshots, gold and coverage ledger before any held-out model output. Development may be inspected before a final freeze; a revision requires a new version and explicit change record.
development_policy: Prompt revision was designed from earlier baseline errors. Both development probes and held-out generation use this pre-frozen version; no adaptation from held-out outputs.
